title: FULL OUTER JOIN
description: Return all rows from both tables with matched and unmatched rows.

data.text: FULL OUTER JOIN returns all rows when there is a match in either table. Unmatched rows are filled with NULL.

data.title: Full Outer Join
data.code:
SELECT u.id AS user_id, o.id AS order_id
FROM users u
FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;

data.title: Use Case
data.text: Use FULL OUTER JOIN for data reconciliation and auditing.

data.title: Exercise: Reconciliation
data.description: Use FULL OUTER JOIN to reconcile users and orders.
data.expectedOutcome: Reconciliation query returns unmatched and matched rows.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: FULL OUTER JOIN returns unmatched rows from both tables.
Use IS NULL to find unmatched rows.
